question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who eats too much
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glutton"** means a person who eats too much; someone who tends to overeat excessively. (पेटू)

 
 
• **Example:** John is a glutton; he always finishes his meals and then asks for more.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fatalist** (नियतिवादी): A person who believes that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.

 
 
• **Example:** Being a fatalist, she believes that everything that happens is meant to be.
 
 
 
• **Sycophant** (चापलूस): A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage; a flatterer.
 
 
• **Example:** He is such a sycophant, always praising the boss's ideas no matter how bad they are.
 
 
 
• **Misogamist** (विवाह विरोधी): A person who hates marriage.
 
 
• **Example:** As a misogamist, he has never considered getting married.
